SELECT
i.itinerary_id AS itineraryId,
i.title AS title,
i.country AS country,
i.city AS city,
i.thumbnail_img AS thumbnailImg,
i.visibility AS visibility,
/* 좋아요 개수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l
WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id
) AS likeCount,
/* 북마크 개수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK b
WHERE b.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id
) AS bookmarkCount,
/* 삭제되지 않은 댓글 개수 */ ( SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM TB_ITINERARY_COMMENT c
WHERE c.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id
AND c.status = 'ACTIVE'
) AS commentCount
FROM TB_ITINERARY i
WHERE i.user_id = #{userId}
AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

SELECT
i.itinerary_id AS itineraryId, i.title AS title, i.country AS country, i.city AS city, i.thumbnail_img AS thumbnailImg, i.visibility AS visibility,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS likeCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK bm WHERE bm.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS bookmarkCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_COMMENT c WHERE c.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AS commentCount
FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK b
INNER JOIN TB_ITINERARY i
ON i.itinerary_id = b.itinerary_id
WHERE b.user_id = #{value}
AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC

SELECT
i.itinerary_id AS itineraryId, i.title AS title, i.country AS country, i.city AS city, i.thumbnail_img AS thumbnailImg, i.visibility AS visibility,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS likeCount,

FROM TB_ITINERARY i

AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND i.visibility = 'PUBLIC'

( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_LIKE l WHERE l.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS likeCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ITINERARY_BOOKMARK x WHERE x.itinerary_id = i.itinerary_id ) AS bookmarkCount,

SELECT activityType, activityGroup, activityId, targetId, targetTitle, content, createdAt
FROM (
SELECT 'TIP_POST' AS activityType, 'POST' AS activityGroup, t.tip_id AS activityId, t.tip_id AS targetId, t.title AS targetTitle, t.content AS content, t.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_tip t
WHERE t.user_id = #{value} AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MATE_POST' AS activityType, 'POST' AS activityGroup, m.mate_id AS activityId, m.mate_id AS targetId, m.title AS targetTitle, m.content AS content, m.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_mate m
WHERE m.user_id = #{value} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TIP_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, t.tip_id AS targetId, t.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_tip_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_tip t ON t.tip_id = c.tip_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MATE_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, m.mate_id AS targetId, m.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_mate_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_mate m ON m.mate_id = c.mate_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ITINERARY_COMMENT' AS activityType, 'COMMENT' AS activityGroup, c.comment_id AS activityId, i.itinerary_id AS targetId, i.title AS targetTitle, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt
FROM tb_itinerary_comment c
INNER JOIN tb_itinerary i ON i.itinerary_id = c.itinerary_id
WHERE c.user_id = #{value} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE'
) activity
ORDER BY createdAt DESC
